name: copilotprompts-copilot-studio-coach
title: Copilot Studio Coach: build better agents, guided
shortDescription: A Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agent that coaches makers to design, build, debug, and ship better Copilot Studio agents, grounded on Microsoft Learn.
longDescription: Copilot Studio Coach helps makers design, build, debug, and ship agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Agent Builder. It recommends the right agent type (declarative, custom, custom engine) and orchestration mode (generative or classic), writes and reviews selection-friendly topic and tool descriptions, debugs generative-orchestration issues such as wrong topic or tool selection, explains Copilot Credits and how to forecast and cap cost, and applies DLP and authentication guidance. It uses a web search capability scoped to the Microsoft Learn Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot documentation so guidance stays grounded in first-party sources, and it recommends rather than acting on the maker's tenant. The sample includes a ready-to-deploy app package for sideloading with the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
